description: Run 1–20 ComputeFirst catalog tools in one request. Optional bindings fill an input key from an earlier result (JSON Pointer); include_result:false omits an intermediate. Steps after a failed dependency are skipped; nothing is retried automatically. Each success is one execution. Inputs, results and response: 256 KiB each. A factory work budget can skip an item with batch_work_limit; finance and exact decimal power/root/expression tools use the full factory allowance. Send additional factory operations separately. Split refused work; successful items are never retried automatically.

model.description: Optional: your model id, only so savings can be shown per model

bindings.description: Fill distinct top-level input keys from earlier successful results; keys must be absent from input.

from.description: Zero-based earlier operation index; no forward/self references.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into that operation result, not its receipt. Empty selects the whole result.

include_result.description: False returns a success receipt only; the bounded result remains available to later bindings and consent-gated audit. Omission does not bypass the batch work budget.

name: execute_batch
title: Run tools in one batch
